_note: 演示视频旁白的文字记录，随提交材料一起打包：docs/04 的逐字稿与视频里的中英双语字幕都由这份记录核对（tools/script_audit.py）。出片脚本（工作区 .taste-skill/video/build.py）用同一份文字喂系统语音合成，故 zh 与视频里听到的逐字相同。audio_seconds 是每段旁白音频的实测时长；zh_cues 是该段被切成的中文字幕句数，与 en 的行数一一对应。

snapshot.note: 视频里念到的每个数字都冻结在这一天的数据快照上（data/processed 的 dashboard_data.json span.end）。页面每天 06:10（马来西亚时间）自动重算，所以在线页可能比视频新一天到几天；片头卡与片尾卡都印了这个日期。tools/narration_audit.py 会把这个日期与现算值逐条核对。

shot1.zh: 在马来西亚沙巴的仙本那，珊瑚礁养着潜水旅游和上千个家庭。但珊瑚正被三件事压着：海水越来越热、暴雨把泥沙冲进近岸、大浪折断礁体。潜店明天要不要出海，只能靠感觉。
en: In Semporna, Sabah, Malaysia,
coral reefs feed dive tourism and more than a thousand households.
But three things press on the reef: warmer seas,
storm runoff washing silt into the shallows, and waves that break the reef itself.
Whether a dive shop can go out tomorrow is still guesswork.

shot2.zh: 我们用四年公开数据，算出这个站点的病历。二零二四年，全球第四次白化事件的高峰年，这里有十五个复合灾害日、四十六个热压力日，是全记录最重的一年；二零二六年最高海温三十一点四五摄氏度、单日降水四十八点二毫米。
en: Using four years of open data, we built this station's medical record.
2024 — the peak of the fourth global bleaching event —
saw 15 compound-hazard days and 46 heat-stress days here,
the worst year in the whole record;
in 2026 the peak sea temperature reached 31.45 °C and
a single day brought 48.2 mm of rain.

shot3.zh: 珊瑚哨兵做三件事：用本站历史的前百分之十分位数定阈值；把浪、雨、增水合成零到一的危险指数，海温单列为热压力；再用岭回归预测未来一到十四天，给出经验百分之八十区间。
en: Reef Sentinel does three things: thresholds come from this station's own top decile;
wave, rain and surge combine into a 0–1 hazard index,
while sea temperature is tracked separately as heat stress;
then ridge regression predicts the next 1 to 14 days with
an empirical 80% interval.

shot4.zh: 方向里要的第二件事是识别与优先级。我们用本站海温建三十一天滑动气候态，按霍布迪的定义识别出十三次海洋热浪；当前处于记录第九十二点二百分位、极高档。系统据此把十一月三日与十二月一日设为复测窗口，并给出七条触发—响应标准作业程序。
en: The track's second ask is detection and priority.
We build a 31-day rolling climatology from this station's own SST
and identify 13 marine heatwaves under the Hobday definitions;
today it sits at the 92.2nd percentile of the record — the top level.
The system therefore sets 3 November and 1 December as re-survey windows
and prints a seven-step trigger-and-response SOP.

shot5.zh: 也要请您看这里：二元分类器的曲线下面积只有零点四九五。连续回归在一到十四天都优于持续预报，误差低百分之二十点八到百分之八点九；对常数均值也全时效更低，但三天以上只低千分之几；收缩校准只多赚千分之几，页面仍部署满幅预报。
en: And look here: our binary classifier's AUC is only 0.495.
The continuous regression beats persistence at all four horizons,
cutting error by 20.8% down to 8.9%;
it also beats the constant mean everywhere, but by thousandths beyond three days;
shrinkage calibration adds only thousandths, so the page ships the full forecast.

shot6.zh: 我们把白化预警升级成学习组件：预测未来二十八天是否出现热浪日，四折扩展窗池化平均精度零点三六四，高于现行规则零点三一一与基准零点二四二。
en: We upgraded bleaching watch into a learned component: will a heatwave day occur in the next 28 days?
Four-fold expanding-window pooled average precision is 0.364,
above the current rule's 0.311 and the 0.242 base rate.

shot7.zh: 官方对照做了两层：年度排序与美国国家海洋和大气管理局一致，仅四个年份、样本小；官方站点覆盖了十三次热浪，海温只差零点零一三度；但官方八成二日子在预警状态，只能印证趋势，不能当触发线。
en: The official cross-check works at two levels: the yearly ranking agrees with NOAA,
on only four years — a small sample;
the official station covers all 13 heatwaves, with SST differing by just 0.013 °C;
but it is in alert 82% of the time, so it confirms the trend
and cannot serve as a trigger line.

shot8.zh: 预报要被执行才有价值：系统按档位给潜店、修复队、度假村和管理方写动作。接下来九十天，我们要找两到三家潜店和一支修复队做每日预警。这是研究演示，不是官方预警；停航与闭园以马来西亚气象局和沙巴公园管理局的发布为准。
en: A forecast only counts once it is acted on: the system writes actions by level for dive shops,
restoration teams, resorts and managers.
Over the next 90 days we will run daily warnings with
two or three dive shops and a restoration team.
This is a research demo, not an official warning;
suspending trips or closing sites follows MetMalaysia and Sabah Parks.
